_source: Fit360OS '200 Food Exchange List' PDF (Fit360OS_200_Food_Exchange_List (1).pdf) is the single source of truth. One entry per PDF row, kept under the PDF's own exchange-group category. Macros (cal/protein/carbs/fat/fiber), GI and GL are the PDF's values for that row's serving; `base` = the PDF 'Serving (g)' so nutrition scales linearly from the exact PDF numbers. `serving` = the PDF 'Household Serving'. GI/GL 'N/A' (negligible-carb foods) stored as 0. `pdfId` = the PDF row number.
